acceptance.given: An applicable Consumer requires enable execution with a current bound Candidate identity.

oracle.expected: The real Consumer call surface invokes the Candidate Route and exposes the successful enable execution.
forbidden: Enable is executed only through a simulated or non-real call surface.
oracle.observable: The Consumer invocation record and Candidate Route result produced while the FR-10 selector exercises enable.

acceptance.then: Enable has been executed by the applicable Consumer through its real call surface.
acceptance.when: The FR-10 replay selector exercises the enable transition.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise enable through an applicable real Consumer with the Candidate Route call suppressed; fail when no real Candidate Route invocation is observed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record and require a real applicable-Consumer invocation of the Candidate Route during enable.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserves existing Consumer interfaces and route compatibility while adding real-call verification.

slice_hint.state_transition: Applicable Consumer requires enable execution -> applicable Consumer invokes Candidate Route through its real call surface.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Each applicable Consumer's enable transition has a real Candidate Route invocation and observable result; simulated or absent calls are rejected.

acceptance.given: A request attempts to promote a seed, package, or Skill version, or to admit it to the evaluation set, within TC-D1.

oracle.expected: The Toolchain policy decision rejects the request and retains the requested item outside promotion and evaluation-set membership.
forbidden: A seed, package, or Skill version is promoted within TC-D1.
A seed, package, or Skill version is admitted as an evaluation-set member within TC-D1.
oracle.observable: The policy-evaluation result for the TC-D1 promotion or evaluation-set admission request.

acceptance.then: Seeds, packages, and Skill versions remain non-promoted and outside evaluation-set membership within TC-D1.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain evaluates the requested TC-D1 promotion or evaluation-set admission.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Submit a TC-D1 promotion or evaluation-set admission request; fail if policy evaluation does not reject the boundary violation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject TC-D1 promotion and evaluation-set admission for seeds, packages, and Skill versions.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Does not promote or migrate existing items; adds rejection of prohibited TC-D1 admission requests.

slice_hint.state_transition: TC-D1 promotion or evaluation-set admission requested -> request rejected and membership remains absent.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every TC-D1 promotion or evaluation-set admission request is rejected and produces neither promotion nor evaluation-set membership.

acceptance.given: A bounded external-process or aggregate execution has a defined required coverage set.

oracle.expected: On budget exhaustion, the terminal result is unsuccessful and the coverage comparison retains every required obligation, case, Consumer, and transition.
forbidden: Reduced coverage is accepted because execution budget was exhausted.
oracle.observable: The exhausted-run terminal result and its required-coverage-set comparison, evaluated when the bounded execution completes.

acceptance.then: Budget exhaustion leaves the required coverage set unchanged.
acceptance.when: A bounded external-process or aggregate execution exhausts its budget and coverage preservation is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exhaust the execution budget while attempting to remove a required obligation, case, Consumer, or transition; fail if the preserved coverage comparison accepts the reduction.

slice_hint.behavior_change: On budget exhaustion, retain the complete required coverage set and report an unsuccessful deterministic terminal result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserves existing terminal categories and coverage inputs; disallows coverage reduction as a budget-exhaustion response.

slice_hint.state_transition: Complete required coverage set under bounded execution -> budget exhausted with unchanged required coverage and unsuccessful terminal result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: After budget exhaustion, the coverage comparison still includes every required obligation, case, Consumer, and transition, and the exhausted run is not accepted as successful.
